newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds stay calm despite stronger Chicago.
newsitem.headline: European feeds stay calm despite stronger Chicago.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market remained quietly this afternoon despite a firmer Chicago opening on lower USDA U.S. soybean stocks and a slightly easier dollar, market sources said.

"It is difficult to get the European market moving at the moment and even a cut of 30 million bushels in the U.S. soybean stocks, which drove soymeal futures up $2 to $3 failed to spark business in Europe," one broker said.
Before USDA's release of supply/demand figures Argentine soymeal pellets traded $7 up at $287.50 cif for nearby afloat, after that no trades were reported in this product.
Dutch high protein soymeal changed hands at $314 a tonne fob Rotterdam and Dec Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $157 a tonne cif Rotterdam.--KARER LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
